name: Data Retention
description: Obligations to retain personal and financial data for specified minimum periods under GDPR Art. 5(1)(e), MiFID II Art. 25, and SFTR Art. 4.

name: Cross-Border Data Transfer
description: Requirements governing transfer of personal data to third countries or international organisations, including adequacy decisions and Standard Contractual Clauses under GDPR Chapter V.

name: Consent Management
description: Rules requiring freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous consent from data subjects prior to processing under GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) and Art. 7.

name: Regulatory Reporting
description: Obligations to report transactions, positions and adverse events to competent authorities (FCA, ESMA, ECB) under SFTR, EMIR, and MiFID II transaction reporting requirements.

name: Risk Disclosure
description: Requirements to clearly disclose material investment risks, credit risk, market risk, liquidity risk and operational risks in prospectuses and communications under Prospectus Regulation and PRIIPs.

name: Record Keeping
description: Obligations to maintain accurate, complete and retrievable records of communications, transactions and decisions under MiFID II Art. 16 and GDPR Art. 30.

name: Privacy Notice
description: Requirements to provide transparent fair-processing information to data subjects at point of collection under GDPR Arts. 12–14.

name: Third-Party Management
description: Due diligence requirements, contractual obligations and supervisory responsibilities for data processors, sub-processors and service providers under GDPR Art. 28 and EBA outsourcing guidelines.

name: Lawful Processing Basis
description: Requirement to identify, document and rely on a valid legal basis for every personal data processing activity under GDPR Art. 6.

name: Data Subject Rights
description: Obligations to honour data subjects' rights of access, erasure, rectification, portability and objection under GDPR Arts. 15–22.
